messages:
maya: Quick intake — partner sent a 12B model bundle (safetensors + tokenizer) and asked us to run a quick custody/hash inventory before onboarding. Can someone pick this up?

samir: I can take the checksum verification and S3 placement. Do we have a bucket policy and tags to apply?

olivia: Put under s3://redwood-model-registry/partner-deliveries/2024-06/ with object tag model_owner=partner-x model_family=12b model_stage=raw :white_check_mark:

kevin: For checksum, prefer sha256 over md5 for large files. Ask partner for both if available. Also need the original manifest (manifest.json) that lists file sizes, sha256, file_type (weights/tokenizer/config).

maya: Partner only included a text file called delivery_notes.txt and two blobs. I asked for a manifest, they said they'll upload in an hour. Meanwhile we should create a custody ledger entry and pre-create the registry placeholder.

lena: Create registry placeholder with status=RECEIVED and provenance.source=partner-x. Tag retention=90d and encryption=kms:redwood-prod-kms. I'll handle RBAC for the object ACL.

ingest-bot: system: incoming object detected: s3://partner-dropzone/pmx_v12b/wts.safetensors size=27,435,210,112 bytes. queued for ingest.

samir: Copy command I'll run (FYI):
```
aws s3 cp s3://partner-dropzone/pmx_v12b/wts.safetensors s3://redwood-model-registry/partner-deliveries/2024-06/pmx_v12b/wts.safetensors \
  --storage-class STANDARD --metadata model_version=2024-06-17 model_format=safetensors
```

samir: Then compute sha256 locally: `sha256sum wts.safetensors | awk '{print $1}'` and compare to manifest when they send it. I'll record the value in the ledger.

olivia: Tokenizer files need special handling: tokenizer.json + merges/vocab (if present). We must verify tokenizer consistency with our tokenization tests (small script below).

olivia: tokenization test snippet: `python tests/tokenizer_smoke.py --tokenizer /tmp/pmx_tokenizer` (returns exit 0 for pass). Tag any tokenizer mismatch as QC:TOKENIZER_MISMATCH in registry entry.

kevin: For weights format, check for safetensors vs pytorch checkpoint. If safetensors, verify no pickled objects. If pytorch .pt, run `torch.load(..., map_location='cpu')` inside sandbox. Add note in ledger: load_test=success/fail.

maya: Good. After checks, plan is: 1) mark placeholder RECEIVED, 2) attach manifest + computed checksums, 3) run tokenizer smoke test, 4) run small forward pass smoke (1 batch) on cpu to confirm model loads (no CUDA yet), 5) tag as INGESTED then schedule quantization run.

lena: One more ops requirement: set S3 object tag `access=private` and add object lock hold for 7 days until legal confirms license. I'll set lifecycle to transition to glacier after 30 days unless flagged for retention.

samir: Noted. Also will store `provenance_digest` in metadata which is sha256(manifest.json + delivery_notes.txt). Please ask partner to sign the manifest and include a base64 signature if possible.

maya: Partner uploaded manifest now: manifests/pmx_v12b/manifest.json. They included sizes and md5 only. I asked for sha256 and a signed manifest.

kevin: If partner only provides md5, we still compute sha256 and record mismatch if any. md5 doesn't help for long-term integrity. Ask for GPG-signed manifest or at least an s3 presigned URL with upload time.

lena: I'll add a temporary ACL to allow partner-x-account read for 24h so they can confirm. Then remove. Ops will annotate ledger entry with `partner_confirm_window=24h`.

ingest-bot: system: ledger entry created: ledger_id=ledg_20240617_001, status=PENDING_CHECKSUMS.

olivia: After we have checksums, I'll run a quick eval job: pass a 200-token prompt, check for decoding errors and compare perplexity vs baseline. If decoding errors, flag TAG=DECODE_ERR.

samir: For quant experiments later, we should capture the exact commit id of the quant runner and the quant config (bits, group_size, qtype). I'll add `quant_config_uri` field to the registry placeholder.

maya: Make sure to note license terms from delivery_notes.txt in registry. If it's non-commercial, escalate to legal.

kevin: One small ask — ensure we don't accidentally cache this in shared inference cache. Add header metadata `dont_cache=true` to objects in registry until status=AVAILABLE.

lena: Doing that now. Also adding KMS key usage audit note.

maya: OK, plan of action — Samir run ingest and checks, Olivia run tokenizer + smoke eval, Kevin run load sandbox test, Lena handle ACLs/retention/legal tags. We'll reconvene in this thread with ledger updates. :thumbsup:

samir: Starting copy + sha256 now. Will post ledger update when done.

ingest-bot: system: copy job started job_id=cp_94821

maya: Thanks — ping if manifest is missing fields.

kevin: FYI, if load_test fails, mark registry.status=QUARANTINED and create ticket in JIRA: M-INGEST-QUIRK.

samir: copy complete, computed sha256=3b8a1f9f9c2b7a9d6f4e2a8b2a1e9f3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9, size matches manifest.md5 mismatch noted. Updating ledger.

ingest-bot: system: ledger updated ledger_id=ledg_20240617_001 status=CHECKSUM_MISMATCH
